definitions.short: to muzzle ; by analogy, to stop the nose
definitions.full: H2629. chasam [ חָסַם ] verb stop up, muzzle (Late Hebrew id. , חסום muzzle ; Aramaic חֲסַם bind up fast ) — Qal Imperfect בְּדִישׁוֺ שׁוֺר תַחְסֹם לֹא Deut 25:4 thou shalt not muzzle an ox when it is treading (i.e. threshing); Participle היא וְחֹסֶמֶת Ezek 39:11 and it shall stop (the way of) the passers-by; but read אתהַֿגַּיְא וְחָֽסְמוּ and they shall stop up the valley , Co see ᵐ5 Syrver Hi.
